sources.fullCitation: “Du liebst mich nicht mehr.” Slow-fox. YouTube transfer published by Radiomuseum Hardthausen; the uploader identifies Tanz-Orchester Dajos Béla, reports a Berlin recording in 1932 and gives the music credit “Bob Henders”.
sources.title: Du liebst mich nicht mehr — Dajos Béla, YouTube
sources.creator: Tanz-Orchester Dajos Béla
sources.researchNote: The upload reports a music credit to Bob Henders, a Berlin recording in 1932 and an Odeon first issue, but supplies no catalogue or matrix number. It shows a portrait from a Funk-Almanach rather than the label. Henry König’s Odeon label list separately documents this title with Dajos Béla as O-11667, Be 9946, recorded on 10 June 1932 in Berlin, Schlesische Straße 26, room 4; the release-date column is empty. The same list also assigns Be 9946 to the different title “Heute Nacht oder nie!”, an unresolved matrix inconsistency. The upload has not been matched to a verified pressing or take; neither O-11667 nor the exact session date is assigned to it. The structured year remains the uploader-reported recording year, not a confirmed issue date. The name Bob Henders in these recording descriptions does not by itself resolve the work’s authorship.
